sources.title: BagIt File Packaging Format
sources.governing_subject_operation_default_unit: File-layout/package specification. Opaque payload octets remain accessible. Each payload manifest enumerates every payload file once; valid means complete and all manifest checksums verify. Creation/validation tools MUST support SHA-256 and SHA-512; creation SHOULD default to SHA-512. Payload-Oxum is optional OctetCount.StreamCount (8-bit bytes, number of payload files), not digest validation. Tag manifests are optional; when present they include payload manifests. Paths are relative to bag root, use slash separators and encode LF/CR/percent specially. Interoperability guidance is non-normative. Retention controls, logical asset identity, curator completeness and authenticity are outside these guarantees.
sources.applicability_assessment: Supports chosen copied-directory pilot, arbitrary inventory payload, per-file reference and conditional tag protection. Custodian retention is local policy. Supports rejecting archive-digest completeness/provenance/recovery proof.

sources.title: OCFL Specification
sources.governing_subject_operation_default_unit: Object id is unique locally and stable; URI is SHOULD. Version integers start at one without gaps; consistently padded names are permitted. Prior directories are intended immutable. Content-addressing MUST use sha512 or sha256 and SHOULD use sha512. Manifest values are arrays of physical content paths; version state values are arrays of logical paths. Root inventory is required; version inventories SHOULD exist. Each inventory has a matching-algorithm sidecar. Logs directory MAY exist and its format is out of scope.
sources.applicability_assessment: Supports richer version history/deduplication alternative on filesystem or object storage. Does not choose gallery completeness, version approval or demonstrate recovery. Draft state/content-path wording is imprecise; final avoids the explicit conflation.

sources.title: PREMIS Data Dictionary
sources.governing_subject_operation_default_unit: Model has Objects, Events, Agents and Rights. Fixity digest comparison records an Event and eventOutcome. Equal same-algorithm digests are evidence of unchanged content; fixity is distinguished from structural/format integrity and authenticity. File/Bitstream fixity fields do not establish authorship or restore success.
sources.applicability_assessment: Supports lightweight event-log analogy and logical/fixity/custody distinction, not CSV PREMIS conformance or a deployed system.
